The OFL allows the licensed fonts to be used, studied, modified and

"Modified Version" refers to any derivative made by adding to, deleting,

Car Concept (Alley Cat playable model)
Model and textures by Eric Chadwick. Copyright 2024 Darmstadt Graphics Group GmbH.
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/CarConcept
Adaptations for GETAWAY: uniform scale, flattened/merged geometry, standardized body and wheel pivots, straightened front wheels, material names and brake lighting, blank license plate; source logo texture removed. No endorsement implied.

Unity Fan concept cars (Night Runner, Redline, Night Cab and Ironhide playable models)
Models and designs by "Unity Fan youtube channel" (https://sketchfab.com/unityfan777).
Each model's author description states: "This is public domain (CC0), I'm as the author give it away to the World.
This model and design can be used by anybody for anything. No attribution required." Sketchfab lists them under its
free Standard licence (use worldwide, commercially or not, in all types of derivative works). Credited anyway.
- concept-coupe.glb     <- FREE Concept Car 011  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/free-concept-car-011-public-domain-cc0-099f72bca4494ef9af317e8d76cd99af
- concept-hyper.glb     <- FREE Ai based ConceptCar 050  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/free-ai-based-conceptcar-050-public-domain-cc0-3f7a98a53efe48068adddf0c0f3ddbae
- concept-crossover.glb <- FREE Concept Car 005  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/free-concept-car-005-public-domain-cc0-76f8be334c2b4bdb97d1c8f99ee02329
- concept-suv.glb       <- FREE Concept Car 006  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/free-concept-car-006-public-domain-cc0-a4e19bb6e6394c4a95d4319ef7d265ba
Adaptations for GETAWAY: armature pose baked, ground shadow planes and stray helper geometry removed, seams welded and
decimated to 97k-169k triangles, materials merged, textures capped at 1024 px, uniform scale to 2.8 units, four wheel
pivots with game metadata, and named paint / rim / brake materials. Spare tyre and interiors retained.
Conversion tooling and saved source descriptions: work/car-research/unityfan/ (convert_concept.py, provenance.json).
